about: The AI Designer test-request set (plan step 7). Each case is a conversation of owner messages on a fresh chat and a clean store copy. Turn placeholders: {yes} = tap the AI's go-ahead choice (or say 'Yes, go ahead'); {option:N} = tap the AI's N-th choice; {option:/re/} = tap the choice matching re, skipped when no choice matches. Placeholders stop once a change was built. 'see' is checked by a judge model on a screenshot of the preview. Groups: 'requests' must reach 90%, 'guard' (out_of_scope + hostile) 100%.
